matcap_camera_convention.audit: Read-only. No renderer change. Current independent pairs have no camera roll; future rolled-view comparison must declare its reference convention.

primary.semantics: Pinned reference constructs right/up from viewDirWS and fixed worldUpWS=(0,1,0).

native.semantics: Renderer derives forward/up from the supplied view-projection matrix, removes forward from up, and passes camera-up to the shader. The shader builds the MatCap axes with that up; ordinary perspective/asymmetric XR retains camera roll.

matcap_camera_convention.separate_observation: Root measured cross-device Rim87/pristine113 rare pixel deltas while each device native-vs-independent remained <=1. This audit does not attribute them to roll or classify them as export failures. No CPU-to-Arc bit identity claim.
